nodes.label: Bearer token auth (Authorization header)
nodes.rationale: 401 on /api/stats fixed by moving the token from the ?token= query param to the Authorization: Bearer <token> header; all endpoints use getToken(req) helper reading header first, falling back to query param; CORS configured to allow the Authorization header; sendBeacon replaced with fetch + keepalive.

nodes.label: Module-to-Annex relabeling
nodes.rationale: Buttons changed from 'Module A/B/C/D/E' to 'Annex A/B/C/D/E'; annex titles use full formal names (e.g. 'Annex A — School-Based Incident Report on Bullying').

nodes.label: Remove /dashboard route
nodes.rationale: The /dashboard route was removed from protectedPages; login redirects to /analytics (login_ormoc_city_division_lrp_wired_1.html:228) and the auth-guard non-admin redirect goes to /analytics (auth-guard.js:53). Non-admin sidebar ONLY keeps Submissions + Access Management; Admin Overview stays at /admin.

nodes.label: Annex D CICL redesign
nodes.rationale: Removed per-category D-1-D-6 pills; replaced with a CICL table (LRN, Age, Gender, Disability, Case/Violation, Actions, Status) + Section B intervention narrative + summary counters; School Year moved into the School Information card.

nodes.label: Save Draft + Resume mechanism
nodes.rationale: Save Draft collects all module state (A-E) and POSTs to /api/drafts; page load checks ?draft=REF to resume; draft is auto-deleted after submit; requires the new form_drafts Supabase table (migration 20260730_create_form_drafts.sql).

nodes.label: Partial date encoding (::y:..|m:..|d:..)
nodes.rationale: Fixed partial date preservation using the ::y:...|m:...|d:... encoding so users can fill month/day/year incrementally without losing already-entered parts.

nodes.label: Single-session conflict detection
nodes.rationale: When the page is loaded with ?reason=single_session, the copy switches to 'Already signed in on another device' because only one session per account is allowed.
